stem.en: Photosynthesis makes sugar and oxygen from carbon dioxide and water. Burning sugar in oxygen is exergonic and runs to completion. What does that make photosynthesis?

text.en: Strongly endergonic. It is burning run backwards, uphill in free energy, and it cannot run by itself. Something must push it.
Also exergonic, because plants do it.

feedback.en: It happens because something pushes. A ball rolling uphill is being pushed. The push is Book V.

text.en: Neither; it is a different reaction.

feedback.en: Write both equations. One is the other reversed, atom for atom.

text.en: Exergonic in the day and endergonic at night.

feedback.en: Sunlight supplies the push. The reaction is uphill day and night; the day is when the push is available.

explanation.en: The reverse of an exergonic reaction is endergonic by exactly the same amount. Whatever falls one way must be lifted the other.
